alt: 考生查看錄取結果，發現自己的照片列在未錄取的一側，難過地收起考試用具。
scene_prompt: 名落孫山 means failing an entrance examination or not being admitted. Modern school admissions result board with NO writing or numerals, only a small row of fictional portrait photo cards and simple green check marks on the left, and a separate lower row with plain red cross marks on the right. A teenager in foreground recognizes HIS OWN matching portrait card in the RED CROSS section, shoulders slumped, holding a clear pencil case and exam paper with only simple geometric diagrams. A parent beside him offers a comforting hand on his shoulder while two admitted applicants far behind smile quietly near the green check section. Clearly show exam non-admission without public mockery, shame or extreme distress. Original fictional portraits; no real institution branding.
